preToolUse.bash: dotnet run .github/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- guard-write --harness github; test $? -eq 0 && exit 0 || exit 2
preToolUse.powershell: dotnet run .github/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- guard-write --harness github; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 }

agentStop.bash: dotnet run .github/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- close-out --harness github; test $? -eq 0 && exit 0 || exit 2
agentStop.powershell: dotnet run .github/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- close-out --harness github; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 }
